note: Issue #8737 claims two symptoms. This predicate is for symptom B, the ICE on `InterlockedMax(tex.sample[s][uv], ...)` over an RWTexture2DMS. It is `internal_failure` (exit-code based, per SKILL.md step 4) and deliberately NOT a match on the reported text `cast<X>() argument of incompatible type!`: that message is what a Release build without asserts prints, while an assert-enabled Debug build traps at 0x80000003 with different wording, so a text-only predicate would score every release binary clean and manufacture a false 'fixed'. is_internal_failure() also carries `(?:llvm::)?cast<...>() argument` as a build-agnostic backstop marker, which covers the Release/Linux wording the reporter quoted. Correct behaviour (a clean diagnosed error, the outcome the reporter asks for) exits E_FAIL 0x80004005 and does NOT match. Symptom A -- the silent compile -- is scored separately by match-silent-ub.json; it is deliberately not folded in with any_of, because the two symptoms come from two different source lines in two different translation units and a disjunction would let either one hide the other's absence. Discriminated by control-sample-store.hlsl (same resource, same .sample[s][uv] double subscript, store instead of atomic), captured with --expect no-match.
